hook.name: LeshyClassicQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Leshy classic token pools that collects a controller-governed treasury fee on swaps, denominated in the quote asset. Fees are accrued as ERC-6909 claims via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas and redeemable to the current treasury address. Pool initialization is gated to the registered factory adapter.
